exposure: Timing of surfactant administration (prophylactic vs. therapeutic)
cohort: Preterm infants (<29 weeks gestational age) admitted to a Canadian tertiary neonatal center between 2005-2008 and 2010-2013
finding: The implementation of early routine use of non-invasive respiratory support did not significantly impact overall surfactant utilization, but was associated with a higher rate of therapeutic surfactant administration and a lower incidence of BPD.
